findings.reason: the first case in the same done-when forces a real resolution and a resolution that silently failed cannot pass it, so the pair still measures the guard; the deliverable's "instead of carrying an empty command" already fixes the intended encoding.
findings.text: the second case asserts "the record marking the gate unarmed" but the plan names no field or marker that means unarmed, and a scope with no test file leaves the same record shape (template in `suite_command`, no resolved value) that a project which never declared a template leaves, so the implementing node must invent the encoding rather than read it from the plan

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/crew/dispatch.py` really does read `gates.suite_command` at :2275 and write it verbatim at :2505; `reckon/crew/prompts.py`'s `compose_prompt` (:556) carries no suite command in any form (grep for `gates`/`node_test_files` finds nothing there); `reckon/crew/promotion_records.py` is the substitution home (`SCOPED_SUITE_PLACEHOLDER` :332, `_scoped_suite_command` :370, `_node_test_files` :335); `reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py`'s `_compose_dispatch_prompt` (:1080, returning `compose_prompt` at :1110) is the sole production prompt path, called from `dispatch.py:2333`; `docs/state/reckon/flight.yaml:125` does declare the scoped template.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — the first case is falsified by its declared control (storing the template verbatim leaves `{node_test_files}` in the resolved-command field and prompt, turning it red); the second case is falsified by the same control, since the same mutation leaves the record carrying the template instead of the unarmed state.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the extraction arms sit on node-local disk under the run's scratch (the `$TMPDIR` rule), and logs fall under the run directory by the node contract; nothing is placed in a path that does not survive the run.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the section title and the new test filename (`tests/test_a_run_record_carries_its_suite_command.py`) name the mechanism, with no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated cause matches the code: dispatch records the raw template and the prompt path never receives the command, so an armed worker cannot know what it will be measured with; the mechanism reuses the same resolution promotion applies (`_scoped_suite_command`, which reads the record's `node.write_paths` and `worktree`, both present on the pointer dispatch writes at `dispatch.py:2371`/`:2421`), and it runs on the only production prompt path (`dispatch.py:2333` → `dispatch_claims.py:1080` → `prompts.compose_prompt`), so the resolved value reaches the worker rather than a helper nothing calls.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one deliverable: the run record and the worker prompt carry the suite command promotion will actually run, with the unarmed branch as the same feature's negative case.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §26 presupposes only §13 (the scoped gate arming), which is `done`, and declares no gating edge, matching this cluster's convention that an edge to a landed section would gate nothing; every `plan-section-depends-on` target (`a-review-can-see-the-figure#s10`, `#s12`) and the `plan-informs` target `background-agent-fitness-and-dispatch-scope` resolve, and all six `plan-commits` shas (`c535b074`, `eb848a59`, `3c4e0326`, `51589acd`, `f407e072`, `85495f3b`) resolve via `git cat-file`.
